item.title: The Redis Author Had AI Write an Emulator, 30 Minutes to Run Through All Z80 Instructions
item.description: Redis founder antirez used Claude Code to implement a complete Z80 emulator in 30 minutes, passing the ZEXALL full instruction test. He designed a strict clean-room experiment: first had AI organize documentation, then cut off the network and implemented from scratch. Result: 1200 lines of code, zero bugs, and顺便 also built ZX Spectrum and CP/M environments.

item.title: PostgreSQL 18 Benchmark Data: I Said You Could Kill Your Redis Cache Layer. You Didn't Believe Me.
item.description: Real benchmark data for PostgreSQL 18: async IO + skip scan deliver a massive database performance leap. Production test with 1K concurrent users shows P95 latency dropping from 72ms to 54ms after removing Redis. Third-party benchmarks show 3.4x faster sequential scans.

item.title: PostgreSQL 18 vs Redis: The Day I Realized Our Cache Layer Was Optional
item.description: PostgreSQL 18's async IO and skip scan made our database so fast that Redis caching became optional. Three engineers independently deleted 4,000+ lines of cache code in a single week.
